title: Heated Pool Exercise Groups for Patients With Rheumatic Diseases
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate the effects of heated pool group exercises for patients with inflammatory rheumatic diseases with regard to symptoms (pain, fatigue, stiffness and ability to carry out daily activities).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Referral from a medical doctor to group exercises in heated pool
* Inflammatory rheumatic joint disease
* \> 18 years
* Stable disease
* Mobile phone owner
* Understand and use text messages on mobile phones

Exclusion Criteria:

* Independent living
* Joint surgery previous to the study start
study_population: Patients with inflammatory rheumatic joint diseases with a medical referral to group exercises in heated pool.
